title: D20054;LITT for Spine Tumors
official: Single Center Observational Study Using Spinal Laser Interstitial Thermal Therapy (sLITT) in the Treatment of Spine Metastases and Tumors
summary: The objective of this clinical study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of spinal laser interstitial therapy in the treatment of metastatic spinal tumors. The investigators hypothesize that rates of local tumor control are comparable between conventional open surgical techniques and spinal laser interstitial therapy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Histology confirmed spinal tumor involving the T2-T12 spine segments.
2. Indication for spine stereotactic radiosurgery or palliative intervention.
3. Normal neurologic exam at the time of presentation (Frankel grade E).

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Contraindication to MRI
2. ANY neurologic deficit
3. Tumor spanning more than 3 consecutive vertebral segments
4. Contraindication to general anesthesia
5. Pregnancy
